note: English generation queue only. A full pack is 5 age bands x these paradigms x 4 languages, on the order of 200 clips. Hindi, Nepali, and Mandarin stay in the taxonomy doc until those prompts are written. These files are not generated yet.
scoring: Each section is scored on its own clock: gaze dwell and first look on gazeTarget, and smile, surprise, or flat affect against emotionTrait.

prompts.title: Peek-a-boo (12 to 17 months)
prompts.pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face
prompts.generationPrompt: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, eye-level, zero pan, zero zoom, soft diffused high-key studio light, solid pastel backdrop, 4k 60fps. English only. Actor speaks to a child aged 12 to 17 months. Pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face. Spoken line: "Hello. Where did I go?". Action: At 2 seconds cover the face with both hands. At 4 seconds open the hands, smile, and say ta-da.

prompts.title: Response to name (12 to 17 months)
prompts.pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face
prompts.generationPrompt: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, eye-level, zero pan, zero zoom, soft diffused high-key studio light, solid pastel backdrop, 4k 60fps. English only. Actor speaks to a child aged 12 to 17 months. Pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face. Spoken line: "Look here.". Action: A neutral dot holds the center. At 3 seconds a voice calls the child's name from one side.

sections.whatHappens: Name is called. Expect a look or head turn.

prompts.title: Gaze cue right (12 to 17 months)
prompts.pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face
prompts.generationPrompt: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, eye-level, zero pan, zero zoom, soft diffused high-key studio light, solid pastel backdrop, 4k 60fps. English only. Actor speaks to a child aged 12 to 17 months. Pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face. Spoken line: "Look, over there.". Action: Eyes on camera until 3.5 seconds, then look and point to the upper right.

sections.whatHappens: Look follows the point to the right.

prompts.title: Surprise box (12 to 17 months)
prompts.pacing: very slow, few words, long holds on the face
prompts.generationPrompt: Static locked-off camera on a tripod, eye-level, zero pan, zero zoom, soft diffused high-key studio light, solid pastel backdrop, 4k 60fps. English only. prompts.title: Turn taking (12 to 17 months)
